title: Taylor Swift Sang Part of Her Wedding Vows, While Travis Kelce Was ‘Crying’ Through His
summary: Insiders also revealed that Paul McCartney and Stevie Nicks performed at the reception.
contentText:
Taylor Swift and Travis K elce shed quite a few tears while exchanging vows at their wedding over Fourth of July weekend, according to two attendees who recently shared new details about the event.

Days after the pop star and tight end’s star-studded ceremony at Madison Square Garden in New York City — Today reported that the unnamed guests told NBC News that the newlyweds both got choked up while professing their love for each other at the altar. One person said, “You would think the bride would be the one crying more, but it was actually Travis that was more emotional.”

The attendees also noted that Swift’s vows included a bit of singing, and that there was hardly a dry eye among the many guests who looked on.

Other details the insiders shared included the ultra famous musicians who performed at Swift and Kelce’s reception: Paul McCartney and Stevie Nicks. They added that the Eras headliner didn’t perform at the wedding itself, but that she and Kelce duetted on their favorite rock song the night prior at the rehearsal dinner.

According to a TODAY show segment that aired Monday (July 6), the reception also featured food from the newlywed’s favorite New York City restaurants, and that guests said “there were games to play to win raffle tickets — the items up for raffle? Designer bags, a 1970s Chevrolet Chevelle” that appeared similar to the one the couple drove on their first public outing in September 2023.

Few other guests have shared details about the wedding, but Maren Morris posted a photo of her monogramed napkin from the big day, which featured the “Blank Space” lyric “So it’s gonna be forever …”

Music video director Joseph Kahan posted a photo and wrote on Instagram , “What I will say about the wedding was it was so much funnier and emotional than expected, and as big as it was, it also felt very intimate. And yes, literally everyone was there.”

The event comes just under a year after Swift and Kelce shared news of their engagement in August 2025. After they tied the knot, a sign reading “JUST&T MARRIED” appeared on the big screens outside of MSG. Shortly afterward, the singer’s rep announced in a release shared with Billboard that Adam Sandler had officiated the ceremony, while the bride and groom’s respective siblings — Austin Swift and Jason Kelce — served as man of honor and best man, respectively.

Swift has notched 15 No. 1 hits on the Billboard Hot 100 , scoring her most recent chart-topper just two weeks before her wedding with “I Knew It, I Knew You” from the Toy Story 5 soundtrack. Her latest album, The Life of a Showgirl , spent 12 weeks atop the Billboard 200 .
